notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 12 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 12!

[h2]Overview[/h2]
Beta Demo 12 brings balance changes, bug fixes, and multiplayer improvements! A lot of backend polish went into this update so that it was in good shape for Steam Next Fest!

[h2]Demo Update 12 Changes[/h2]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
-Slinger Ability Nerf
-Shields made Tier 1 and have improved functionality
-Knives now work with Melee Units
-New Campaign faction progression unlocks

[h3]Polish[/h3]
-New Multiplayer matchmaking balance
-Improved Cheat prevention
-Volume Start Glitch fixed
-Widescreen monitors should auto turn off fullscreen mode
-Mushroom Level up works with recruit poster
-Forced bard event glitch fixed
-Witchdoctor essence catcher interaction fixed

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 11!

[h2]Overview[/h2]
Beta Demo 11 brings a ton of new content, graphic updates, bug fixes, refreshed multiplayer servers, and more! It is the largest demo update so far, hope you enjoy.

-New Artifact Items: Witherheart, Final Nail, Starpiece Shard

-New post processing effects and particles on battle screen

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 10 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 10!

[h2]Overview[/h2]
Beta Demo 10 introduces the new Journal feature, 4 new trinkets, Orc Campaign updates, as well as the first balance pass and a handful of bugfixes.

[h2]Demo Update 10 Changes[/h2]

[h3]Content[/h3]
-Journal Added
-New Trinkets: Treasure Chest, Golden Key, Mushroom Log, Blood Stone
-Orc Campaign updated

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
-Mushroom Log Trinket given to all players after round 10 in Vs Mode
-Saboteur changed to a tier II Unit and base stats changed accordingly
-Poisoner changed to a tier III Unit and base stats changed accordingly
-Jester Party Trick ability changed to randomize a random stat, at lvl 3 2 random stats are randomized
-Brawler no longer can team kill with sucker punch ability
-Fatigue Poison no longer uselessly triggers on kill
-Bard event in campaign gives bards for free
-Mirror Morel now gives 600 exp

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
-Starting audio loudness fix
-Start Faction Trinkets Now correctly update between changing screens
-Recruit Poster camp tier IV bug fixed
-Cultist Spirit Branch interaction fixed
-Wraith Cap now correctly subtracts health
-Shop Cards apply proper cost on combine

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 9 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 9! This includes new Greenskin units, and some major bugfixes.

[h2]Content[/h2]
Beta Demo 9 introduces 3 new units for the Greenskin Trading Company. The Brawler, a Tier I unit that damages your own team for a dmg boost. The Galleyman, a Tier II that spreads buffs out after taking damage. Lastly The Witchdoctor, a Tier IV unit that can change the tide of battle after dying. For balance, the Marksmen has been moved to Tier III. In addition, several bugs have been fixed.

[h2]Demo Update 9 Changes[/h2]
-New Units Added: Brawler, Galleyman, Witchdoctor
-Unit Shop Cards now show Tier of Unit
-Trinkets that effect 0 units show 0 in red
-Rare trinkets in the trinket shop bug fixed
-Farmer Bomos Donut Interaction Fixed

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 8 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 8! This includes new Greenskin units, New General Trinkets, and some major bugfixes.

[h2]Content[/h2]
Beta Demo 8 introduces 4 new units for the Greenskin Trading Company. The Sailor, a Tier I unit useful for getting some early game HP buffs. The Sneak, a Tier II unit good for countering those high armor opponents. The Freebooter, a Tier III unit with strong shop and summon synergies. Lastly, the Sawbones, a self team debuffing unit with high risk/reward. In addition 4 new general trinkets have been added, and several bugs have been fixed.

[h2]Demo Update 8 Changes[/h2]
-New Units Added: Sailor, Sneak, Freebooter, Sawbones
-New Trinkets Added: Essence Catcher, Chew Toy, Recruitment Poster
-Campaign Softlock caused by elite nodes fixed
-Visual Bug With Royal Sigil Fixed
-Various Farewell Letter bugs fixed
-Reduced Music Volume on first start
-Cultist Ability Rebalanced
-Discount Token Rebalanced
-Jester Ability Tooltip Clarified

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 7 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 7! This includes many updates to the single player campaign, new trinkets, and bug fixes.

[h2]Content[/h2]
Beta Demo 7 introduces a reworked campaign system and shard shop. The shard shop allows you to buy trinkets prior to your campaign run. You now have a little more control in setting up a "dream combo" of trinkets. Earn shards by playing the game and earning a high score. Increase your score with new cursed trinkets, making the game harder but rewarding you with a higher score. In addition several new trinkets have been added to the game, along with single player performance improvements and bug fixes.

[h2]Demo Update 7 Changes[/h2]
-New Trinkets Added: Discount Token, Farewell Letter, Scrap Metal, Fatigue Poison, Toll Chest
-Shard Shop and system added to campaign mode
-Cursed Trinket functionality added
-Options Menu Bug fixes
-Bellman Ahnk visual bug fixed
-Campaign Load times improved by nearly 50%

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 6 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 6! This includes the addition of 4 new Greenskin Trading Co. Units and the introduction of the Experimental multiplayer format.

[h2]Content[/h2]
Beta Demo 6 introduces 4 new units! The Angler, a unit that provides fish in the shop. The Smuggler, a unit that "acquires" free items in the shop. The Trapper, a strong counter to summoning units. And the Harpoonist, a very strong ranged unit. A new multiplayer format called "Experimental" has been added. In the experimental format, for the first time the pool of possible units is combined between some units from both factions. This should open the door to new and unique strategies, yet to be discovered. In addition, new trinkets and smaller changes have been added.

[h2]Demo Update 6 Changes[/h2]
-Angler, Trapper, Smuggler, and Harpoonist added to GTC
-Experimental Multiplayer format is now available
-Hope loss tweaked so that it is less punishing early on
-Tooltips added to win/lose multiplayer screen
-Close Combat Manual Trinket Added
-Tragedy Mask Trinket Added

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 5 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 5! This includes the addition of the VS multiplayer mode and some bug fixes.

[h2]Content[/h2]
In the VS multiplayer mode, you will fight teams built by other players. If you can get 10 victories before you lose all of your hope you win! Over the course of a run, you will unlock new units, items, and trinkets. So you will have to adapt your strategy over time. In addition to the multiplayer mode, several bugs have been fixed and polish items added.

[h2]Demo Update 5 Changes[/h2]
-Playmode select screen added
-Multiplayer Mode Added
-Camera Zoom added for teams that grow to more then 5 units
-Idle Animations added for Units (Option added for turning them off)

Bugs
-Ahnk and Bannerman summoning to wrong team fixed
-Sold in shop abilities now correctly trigger with one Unit

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 4 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 4! This includes the addition of a new faction and some bug fixes

[h2]Content[/h2]
The Greenskin Trading Co. has been added to the game! The Greenskin Trading Company is known around the world for "collecting" rare goods from around the world. They have a playstyle focused on economic, ranged, and utility units. Items and trinkets specifically for the GTC have also been added. In addition some long standing bugs have been resolved.

[h2]Demo Update 4 Changes[/h2]
-Faction Select Screen Updated
-First 15 Greenskin Trading Co. Units added
-Greenskin Trading Co. Items added
-Greenshin Trading Co. Trinkets Added
-Skipping map nodes bug fixed
-Summoning mechanic made more reliable
-Ahnk Trinket changed to affect the first Unit to die

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 3 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 3! This includes a combination of content, polish, and bug fixes. 

[h2]Content[/h2]
3 new Units, Trinkets, and Events as well as mechanical tweaks to elite nodes have been added. The new units include the Alchemist, a unit that counters others with strong armor, the Bellman a unit who buffs others when bought and summoned, and a Bannerman a powerful unit that summons other units at the start of battle. In addition elite node rewards have been tweaked. Upon completing a elite node you are now given a array of rewards to choose from. This allows elite nodes to be a little more worth the challenge and give the player some agency in choosing their rewards. There is also new trinkets and events to discover as well as polish and bug fixes. Find a summary of the major changes below.

[h2]Demo Update 3 Changes[/h2]
-Faction Select Screen Updated
-Alchemist, Bellman, and Bannerman added to game
-New Elite reward System Added
-Eternally Fresh Event Added
-Ancient Ingredients and Ancient Feast Items added
-Wraith Cap and Mirror Morale Items added
-Skybox, lighting, and post processing improvements
-Options screen now accessible in game via the 'Esc' key
-Battle Softlock from ranged units fixed

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 2 Update[/h1]

The Mirror Throne Beta demo has been updated to demo 2! This includes a combination of content, polish, and bug fixes. 

[h2]Content[/h2]
3 new Units and a new trinket have been added. The Jester, a risky but fun early game unit, whose damage value is randomized at the start of battle. The Poisoner, a hard counter to high health units. When the Poisoner dies, they remove health (up to 100% at max level) from the attacker that killed them. Lastly, the Saboteur, a hard counter to strong ranged units. The Saboteur reduces the attack value and may even switch a range unit to melee at the beginning of battle. There is also a new trinket, called the Badge Of Honor. It gives mercenary units the ability to inherit keywords from their teammates, unlocking some powerful new combinations. The faction progress has been reset, and you will need to get the Kingdom Of Drava faction to level 5 to unlock the Saboteur and the Badge Of Honor.

[h2]Polish And Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Better Map Orientation
	-Added player marker to indicate what node you are on
	-Fixed tooltips for nodes to better reflect where you have been
-Shop Improvements
	-Reroll tooltip turned back on
	-Costs and sell values appear in card tooltips
	-Right click to cancel out of shop actions
	-Added option in options menu to turn of auto sorting for cards (after buying one the rest stay still)
	-Fixed ending turn with now team and rerolling all money soft locks
	-Enemy Preview in shop tooltips now account for the units level
-Unit Combination Improvements
	-improved unit combine particle system so that it is more obvious
	-Higher level unit combining results in more xp
		-Units exp worth is their level x 100
			-Results in 2 level 2’s combining to make a 3 and so on
-General
	-Popup numbers in battle correctly display 0’s and negative numbers
	-Fixed overlap glitch on faction progress panel
	-Vsync Option added and turned on by default
	-Improved logging to better hunt softlocks
	-Loading map screen from battle should be faster
	-Summon Animations made more apparent
	-Tooltips are now visible in battle
	-Scholar Empty space buff fixed
	-Well Made Sword not applying dmg increase fixed

notes.title: Mirror Throne Demo Live Now!
notes.content:
[h1]The Mirror Throne Public Demo is Now Live![/h1]

I am happy to announce the public demo for Mirror Throne is now live! This is a small vertical slice that shows off the core game loop and replay ability. I hope to update this demo over time with new content and polish. In the mean time I am gathering feedback on the discord in order to make the game be the best it can be. If you could playtest it, and leave some feedback that would be much appreciated.

Thanks For Playing :)

-Zack, Solo Dev of Mirror Throne
